quote_caption_ru:
"And what do you care about clothes? Look at the lilies of the field, how they grow: they neither toil nor spin;

but I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not clothed like any of them." – Иисус Христос
quote_caption_en: "And what do you care about clothes? Look at the lilies of the field, how they grow: they neither toil nor spin; but I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not clothed like any of them." – Jesus Christ
script_ru: И что вам до одежды? Посмотрите на лилии полевые, как они растут: не трудятся и не прядут; но говорю вам, что и Соломон во всей славе своей не одевался так, как одна из них.
script_en: And what do you care about clothes? Look at the lilies of the field, how they grow: they neither toil nor spin; but I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not clothed like any of them.
